#read pathway tbl
```{r}
#high
Sphingopyxis_pwy <- fread("../gapseq/4genome/Sphingopyxis/Sphingopyxis-all-Pathways.tbl")
Bacillus_pwy <- fread("../gapseq/4genome/Bacillus/Bacillus-all-Pathways.tbl")
#low
Paraburkholderia_pwy <- fread("../gapseq/4genome/Paraburkholderia/Paraburkholderia-all-Pathways.tbl")
Ralstonia_pwy <- fread("../gapseq/4genome/Ralstonia/Ralstonia-all-Pathways.tbl")

#merge into one 
lst <- list(
  Sphingopyxis_sp001990265= Sphingopyxis_pwy,
  Bacillus_pumilus = Bacillus_pwy,
  Ralstonia_insidiosa = Ralstonia_pwy,
  Paraburkholderia_tropica = Paraburkholderia_pwy
)

clean_tbl <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(Name, ID, Prediction) %>%
    mutate(Prediction = ifelse(tolower(Prediction) == "true", 1, 0))
}
lst2 <- map(lst, clean_tbl)
df_merged <- reduce(lst2, function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = c("ID", "Name")))
#re-name
colnames(df_merged) <- c(
  "Pathway", "ID",
  names(lst)   # Sphingopyxis, Bacillus, Paraburkholderia, Ralstonia
)

#write.csv(df_merged, '../gapseq/pathway.csv')
```

#vsurf
```{r}
library(VSURF)
#risk score from survival script
#write.csv(dat, '../gapseq/meta_data_risk_score.csv')
meta <- read.csv("../gapseq/meta_data_risk_score.csv", check.names = FALSE)
meta <- meta[, -1]
#rownames(meta) <- meta$sampleID
# add new name of the samples: p1- p38
meta <- meta %>%
  arrange(Order)
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(plot_name = paste0("P", seq_len(n())))
rownames(meta) <- meta$plot_name

# order by risk score
meta <- meta %>% arrange(risk_score)

y <- meta$risk_score
names(y) <- meta$plot_name

# abund data
four_taxa <- c(
  "Bacteria;Proteobacteria;Alphaproteobacteria;Sphingomonadales;Sphingomonadaceae;Sphingopyxis;Sphingopyxis_sp001990265",
  "Bacteria;Firmicutes;Bacilli;Bacillales;Bacillaceae;Bacillus;Bacillus_pumilus",
  "Bacteria;Proteobacteria;Gammaproteobacteria;Burkholderiales;Burkholderiaceae;Ralstonia;Ralstonia_insidiosa",
  "Bacteria;Proteobacteria;Gammaproteobacteria;Burkholderiales;Burkholderiaceae;Paraburkholderia;Paraburkholderia_tropica"
)

X_abund <- meta[, four_taxa, drop = FALSE]

# reorder
X_abund <- X_abund[match(meta$plot_name, rownames(X_abund)), ]
stopifnot(all(rownames(X_abund) == meta$plot_name))
colnames(X_abund) <- c(
  "Sphingopyxis_sp001990265",
  "Bacillus_pumilus",
  "Ralstonia_insidiosa",
  "Paraburkholderia_tropica"
)


#get pathway genome
pathway_genome <- df_merged %>%
  dplyr::select(Pathway,
                Sphingopyxis_sp001990265,
                Bacillus_pumilus,
                Ralstonia_insidiosa,
                Paraburkholderia_tropica
                ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Pathway")
stopifnot(identical(colnames(X_abund), colnames(pathway_genome)))
#

#  get pathway abundance 
# (samples × bacteria matrix) %*% (bacteria × pathway matrix)
X_pathway_abund <- as.matrix(X_abund) %*% t(as.matrix(pathway_genome))

rownames(X_pathway_abund) <- rownames(X_abund)
colnames(X_pathway_abund) <- rownames(pathway_genome)

X_pathway_abund <- as.data.frame(X_pathway_abund)



#VSURF
set.seed(123)  

vsurf_path <- VSURF(
  x        = X_pathway_abund,
  y        = y,
  parallel = T  
)
# The pathway orders in the results are different everytime, because we used parallel. But the Top pathways are the same.
vsurf_path
# get table
imp_df <- data.frame(
  rank    = vsurf_path$imp.mean.dec.ind,
  pathway = colnames(X_pathway_abund)[vsurf_path$imp.mean.dec.ind],
  imp_mean= vsurf_path$imp.mean.dec,
  imp_sd  = vsurf_path$imp.sd.dec,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

head(imp_df, 20)
#write.csv(imp_df, "../gapseq/VSURF_pathway_importance_risk_score.csv", row.names = FALSE)
#plot
top_n <- 20
top_imp <- imp_df[1:top_n, ]
top_imp$pathway <- factor(top_imp$pathway, levels = rev(top_imp$pathway))

ggplot(top_imp, aes(x = imp_mean, y = pathway)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "VSURF importance (mean decrease)", y = "Pathway") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid  = element_blank()
  )

```

# complex heatmap
```{r}

X_pathway_abund_filt <- X_pathway_abund

mat0 <- as.matrix(X_pathway_abund_filt)
storage.mode(mat0) <- "numeric"

bad_col <- apply(mat0, 2, function(z) any(is.na(z) | is.infinite(z)))
mat0 <- mat0[, !bad_col, drop = FALSE]

zero_sd <- apply(mat0, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
mat0 <- mat0[, !zero_sd, drop = FALSE]

X_pathway_abund_filt <- as.data.frame(mat0)

meta2 <- meta[match(rownames(X_pathway_abund_filt), meta$plot_name), ]

med <- median(meta2$risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)
meta2$risk_group <- ifelse(meta2$risk_score >= med, "High risk", "Low risk")
meta2$risk_group <- factor(meta2$risk_group, levels = c("Low risk", "High risk"))

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  RiskGroup = meta2$risk_group
)
rownames(annotation_col) <- meta2$plot_name

ann_colors <- list(
  RiskGroup = c(
    "Low risk"  = "#5DAF85",  
    "High risk" = "#FD9919"   
  )
)

mat <- as.matrix(X_pathway_abund_filt)
mode(mat) <- "numeric"
mat2 <- t(mat)

top30 <- head(imp_df[order(imp_df$imp_mean, decreasing = TRUE), ], 30)
top30_pathways <- top30$pathway
mat2_top30 <- mat2[top30_pathways, , drop = FALSE]

abund_colors <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#5E8DB6",  
  "#FFFFFF",  
  "#DDA39A"   
))(200)


pdf("../gapseq/vsurf_heatmap_top30_tricolor.pdf", width = 11, height = 5.5)

pheatmap(
  mat2_top30,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = F,
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "average",
  color = abund_colors,
  legend = TRUE,
  legend_labels = "Pathway abundance",   
  legend_breaks = NA,                
  fontsize = 10,
  fontsize_row = 10,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  angle_col = 45,
  border_color = 'grey',
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  annotation_names_row = FALSE,
  annotation_legend = TRUE,
  treeheight_col = 10#,
  # cellwidth = 4,
  # cellheight = 4
)

dev.off()
```
